name: NeoCalculator v1 final 5x10 · revision C canonical

combined.math: ALPHA remains uppercase; SHIFT+ALPHA uses explicit combined definitions or SHIFT precedence
combined.code: ALPHA letters are lowercase; SHIFT+ALPHA letters are uppercase

consumption.rule: A plane consumes only the one-shot modifiers it actually uses when the resolved key definition has consumesModifier=true. Locked modifiers persist.

modifierPolicy.lostReleasePolicy: Modifier state is logical and press-triggered; any scanner force-release clears physical held state. HOME, shutdown, reset and recovery clear both modifiers.

legend.shiftAlpha: combined logical plane; not printed as a fourth physical legend

notes: Visual coordinates are not the production PCBA electrical row/column mapping.
Toolbox is contextual; SHIFT+Toolbox opens the full searchable catalog.
VAR opens the quick variable picker; SHIFT+VAR opens the variable manager.
FORMAT changes result representation; SHIFT+FORMAT opens TABLE.
The hidden SHIFT+1…6 actions remain context-sensitive soft keys but are not printed on the production keycaps.
SHIFT+LEFT/RIGHT jump to the beginning/end of the current expression; SHIFT+UP/DOWN page through long views using the compact ↥ and ↧ legends.
The contextual x,t,θ,n key inserts the active independent variable; SHIFT inserts y.
ALPHA programming punctuation includes {, }, #, ⎵, _, quotes, @, backslash, ampersand and vertical bar.
Code context maps the mathematical power key to ^, multiply to *, divide to /, and shifted comparisons to !=, <= and >=.
ALPHA letters are uppercase mathematical variables; in code context ALPHA produces lowercase and SHIFT+ALPHA produces uppercase.
SHIFT+AC enters the normal deep-sleep OFF state; the separate hardware switch performs true power isolation.
Hyperbolic trigonometric functions live in the trig long-press family and Toolbox rather than on permanent printed legends.

keys.notes: SHIFT is one-shot. A second press or long press locks it; lock status is shown on-screen, not printed as a secondary legend.
ALPHA is one-shot. A second press or long press locks it. With SHIFT also armed, the combined SHIFT+ALPHA plane is used.
SHIFT pages upward in long history, menus, editors, or result views.
BACK has no separate SHIFT function; an armed modifier is preserved.
SHIFT jumps to the beginning of the current expression or line.
SHIFT pages downward in long history, menus, editors, or result views.
SHIFT jumps to the end of the current expression or line.
Contextual toolbox; SHIFT opens the complete searchable catalog.
Primary inserts the context-selected independent variable (x/t/θ/n); SHIFT inserts y.
Math legends show the natural fraction and mixed-number templates.
SHIFT inserts an absolute-value template instead of the redundant cube-root shortcut.
General power is primary; SHIFT inserts an editable-index root.
Square is primary; SHIFT inserts the reciprocal exponent −1.
SHIFT+AC enters the normal ultra-low-power OFF/deep-sleep state for instant wake. The separate hardware switch performs full power isolation.

contexts.text: Plain-text editor; aliases the code character rules

math.shiftAlphaLetters: explicit shiftAlpha definition; letters remain uppercase
